positioning.for_who: office workers in the Kakkanad tech park
positioning.problem: skip lunch or eat fried food because nothing home-style arrives by 1 pm
positioning.what_it_is: a weekly home-style lunch subscription delivered to the desk
positioning.unlike: ordering a different meal from a delivery app every day

promise: A home-style lunch at your desk by 1 pm, or that day is free.

voice.do: Say what is in the box and what it costs
voice.do_not: Use food adjectives nobody says out loud

voice.do: Write like the cook who knows your order
voice.do_not: Write like a notice from a company

voice.do: Give the time, the price and the menu

name_checks.note: Owner searched the public trade mark register on 2026-11-12, class 43, no match
Owner to check the two social handles
Owner asked three Malayalam and two Hindi speakers, no bad meaning

channels.name: Lunch-hour tasting table in the tech park lobby
channels.first_action: Ask the facilities desk for a table on two days
channels.measure: Sign-ups on the paper sheet per tasting day

channels.name: Office floor chat groups
channels.first_action: Ask five people who signed up to post the menu in their floor group
channels.measure: Orders that name a floor group on the order form

channels.name: Printed menu card in the lift lobby
channels.first_action: Print 50 cards with a code to scan
channels.measure: Scans of the code per week

first_test.what: Offer a five-day paid trial week to people who taste the food
first_test.pass: At least 12 of the 60 people asked pay for the trial week
first_test.fail: Fewer than 6 of the 60 pay; stop and rework the offer
first_test.measure: Paid trial weeks counted from the payment record

countdown.task: Confirm the lobby table with the facilities desk
Print the menu cards and the sign-up sheet
Count paid trial weeks against the pass mark

before_promotion.fix: Write the refund rule on the order form

accessibility.pair: Menu card text on card background
